candidates.title: Desktop Controls Orientation Module Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive orientation screen before the final completion screen to teach users how to summon, move, hide, and talk to their desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and 28.3% drop off between home and finish steps.

new_desktop_controls.headline: Quick Desktop Controls Guide
new_desktop_controls.body: Learn how to summon, click, drag, and toggle your pet's desktop presence in a few simple taps.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a desktop controls orientation screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at highest drop-off step with support backing, but requires a whole new screen.

candidates.title: Centered Journey Pathways Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path choice screen into a centered layout with distinct card visualizers for adopting standard presets vs generating custom pets.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen has an 84.5% conversion with a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or decision inertia.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Experience
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play pet or craft a customized companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Redesigned path selection screen retains both adoption and custom pet choices.

candidates.score_note: Solves long mean time on choose_path, though evidence comes mostly from funnel data.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Assistant Flow
candidates.change: Adds a new validation step during photo upload that checks image clarity and gives live feedback prior to pet rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output, contributing to the long 1017s mean duration in adoption.

new_photo_validator.headline: Photo Clarity Inspection
new_photo_validator.body: We checked your image to ensure the best rendering quality on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a photo quality verification screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong support and funnel alignment for adoption failures, but adds a new flow step.

candidates.title: Centered Stage Waiting Experience Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a stage layout showing live status stages as the desktop pet assets are generated.
candidates.why: The waiting/home phase exhibits a huge mean duration of 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pet spawning or launch stalls.

waiting.headline: Summoning Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Preparing desktop environment and initializing rendering engine...

guard.reason: Redesigned waiting screen continues to show pet creation progress.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the largest mean time bottleneck (2336s) and spawn stall support tickets.

candidates.title: Existing Account Restore Verification Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit sign-in hint text reassuring returning users that signing in restores all previous pet profiles automatically.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in.

sign_in.hint: Signing into an existing account safely recovers all previous pets and customizations.

guard.reason: Sign-in hint text provides clear information without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addressing the single largest support ticket volume (8 emails).

candidates.title: Certificate Name Entry Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Updates the adoption certificate copy to clarify that naming the pet is quick and can be modified anytime in settings later.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 80.2% with 89s median / 1017s mean time spent.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a name. You can change this at any time in app settings.

guard.reason: Adoption certificate copy update maintains official certificate function.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak targeting adoption hesitation, backed primarily by funnel timing.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Troubleshooter Wait Info
candidates.change: Adds a troubleshooting hint and timer delay on the waiting screen for users experiencing slow desktop spawning.
candidates.why: 3 users reported desktop pet visibility bugs or app launch stalls during the waiting step.

waiting.hint: If pet initialization takes longer than 30 seconds, verify desktop notification permissions.

guard.reason: Troubleshooting hint and tip delay on waiting screen comply with fair wait rules.

candidates.score_note: Helps manage long wait times on home step supported by user launch stall complaints.

candidates.title: System Tray Quick Hide Notification Switch
candidates.change: Enables a system ready notification toggle on home intro along with instructions on using the system tray icon to control pet visibility.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion around hiding or revealing the pet once onboarding finishes.

home_intro.hint: Use the system tray icon anytime to quickly hide or show your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Notification toggle and hint on home intro are valid onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Directly tackles post-onboarding pet visibility issues reported in finish support tickets.

candidates.title: Instant Desktop Companion Path Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a highlighted time-estimate badge on choose_path comparing instant preset adoption with photo customization.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 15.5% drop-off rate and high mean completion time (514s).

guard.reason: Creates urgency or pressures choices using time comparisons

candidates.why: 2 support tickets mentioned sign-in screen stalling or failing to show, and sign_in mean duration is high at 567s.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Companion Data

guard.reason: Compact layout update for sign-in screen maintains sign-in job.
